title: IT10 Charset UTF-8 통합 테스트 (F3 boundary)

red_evidence.note: Test authored fresh — pre-existence absence served as red baseline. F3 charset boundary verified through (a) explicit charset=UTF-8 round-trip of Korean payload via javax HttpServlet→ServletConverter.convert→jakarta Servlet→Tomcat→HTTP wire→client decode chain, (b) absent-charset fallback policy where servlet reads raw bytes via getInputStream() preserving byte-for-byte fidelity (adapter must not fabricate corrupting charset). Pattern matches IT02PostTest (UTF-8 form body) which already exercises charset handling on the F1 path.

impl_iters.note: 3 parallel test classes (one per servlet module: 5/6/61). Each contains 2 @Test methods: shouldRoundTripUtf8 (explicit charset=UTF-8 Korean round-trip — asserts status 200, response Content-Type contains charset=utf-8, decoded body equals KOREAN_PAYLOAD) + shouldFallbackCharset (no Content-Type charset parameter — asserts status 200, X-Observed-Charset header surfaced, raw bytes preserved byte-for-byte). Modules differ only by ServletConverter import (servletElementConverter5/6/61) and Tomcat version mentioned in javadoc.

green_evidence.stdout_excerpt: BUILD SUCCESSFUL (servlet5: 10s, servlet6+servlet61: 26s) — 14 actionable tasks: 8 executed, 6 up-to-date. integrationTest + test + jacocoTestReport PASS on all 3 modules.

dod_check.notes: shouldRoundTripUtf8: Korean payload '안녕하세요, 스노우오르카!' encoded UTF-8 → POST with Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8 → javax HttpServlet receives via getInputStream → adapter (javax↔jakarta) → response with charset=UTF-8 → client decodes UTF-8 → assertEquals(KOREAN_PAYLOAD, echoed). Verified on Tomcat 10.0.27 (servlet5), 10.1.30 (servlet6), 11.0.0 (servlet61).

dod_check.item: Content-Type 무 명시 폴백 정책 PASS
dod_check.notes: shouldFallbackCharset: POST with Content-Type: text/plain (no charset parameter) → servlet reads raw bytes via getInputStream() preserving payload byte-for-byte → assertEquals(payload.length, echoedBytes.length) + equalBytes(payload, echoedBytes). X-Observed-Charset header surfaces what the servlet API reported (null when client omitted; container default otherwise), confirming adapter does not fabricate a corrupting charset. F3 fallback policy validated.

regression.note: 3-module integrationTest + test + jacocoTestReport chain BUILD SUCCESSFUL. No changes to TomcatRunner, ServletConverter, or any adapter sources — pure test additions. IT01~IT09 unaffected (gradle re-ran them up-to-date for servlet5; only IT10 sources newly compiled).
